 Korean clean beauty brand PLAN de G made its official Singapore debut on 13 November 2026 , and its three products are on sale now through the PLAN de G Online Store and Shopee . If your bathroom shelf has more bottles than your fridge, the pitch is aimed at you: one cleanser that, according to the brand, does the work of a makeup remover, a cleansing oil and a cleansing foam.
 That is a big promise in a beauty culture that has spent years telling us more steps equal better skin. So it’s fair to ask whether skipping steps holds up, or whether “less is more” is a new way to sell the same bottles.
 The PLAN de G cleanser, cream and serum: one bottle doing the work of three? The 10-Step Hangover
 If you’ve spent any time on skincare TikTok or Instagram, you know the routine videos: toner, essence, two serums, an ampoule, a cream, maybe a sleeping mask, all patted in with ceremony. It looks soothing on a phone screen, but it gets expensive, slow and confusing fast, especially when you can’t tell which product is doing the heavy lifting.
 The PLAN de G cleanser, serum and cream, the trio behind the brand’s three-step routine for Singapore PLAN de G’s own origin story starts from that frustration. Even with access to luxury skincare and professional treatments, founder Ayin found that a routine of 11 to 13 products didn’t consistently give her the results she wanted. That pushed her to look harder at ingredient quality and formulation, and the brand grew out of it.
 The brand calls its approach skin-minimalism , backed by what it terms a “Re” philosophy of Recovery, Regeneration and Rebuilding. Strip away the branding and the message is refreshingly plain: fewer products, each one with a clear job.
 One Bottle, Three Jobs
 The headliner is the PLAN de G Triple All-in-one Oil to Foam Cleanbeauty Cleanser , and it’s the product that makes the “fewer steps” claim most concrete. It starts as an oil to lift off everyday makeup, sunscreen and grime, then turns into a soft, dense foam once water hits it. PLAN de G says this cuts down on repeated washing and the rubbing that comes with a double cleanse.
 The 150ml Triple All-in-one Oil to Foam Cleanbeauty Cleanser, which PLAN de G pitches as remover, oil and foam in one One detail worth knowing before you bin your makeup remover: the brand states the formula is meant for everyday makeup, not waterproof makeup . So if your daily look involves smudge-proof mascara or a long-wear liner, you’ll probably still want something stronger on the side.
 Centella asiatica and portulaca extracts are there for soothing. The brand says the goal is to tackle that tight, squeaky feeling many people get after washing their face.
 What’s a Synbiotic, Anyway?
 Here’s where the science talk comes in. PLAN de G builds its formulas around Super Synbiotics™ , an ingredient system the brand says it developed on its own. It combines probiotics (live “good” microbes), prebiotics (food for those microbes) and postbiotics (the useful compounds microbes leave behind). The target is your skin microbiome, the community of microorganisms that naturally lives on your skin.
 The brand leans on Korean fermentation traditions here. Kelp serves as the prebiotic base, and fermentation-derived postbiotics round it out. It’s a fun origin for a skincare ingredient, and fans of Korean food will appreciate the nod.
 Now for the healthy dose of skepticism. A cleanser sits on your face for about as long as it takes to massage and rinse, so it has far less time to do anything than a serum or cream you leave on all night. Treat the microbiome promises as PLAN de G’s claims, and judge the cleanser on what you can feel: does it remove your makeup, and does your skin feel tight afterwards?
 Serum and Cream Finish the Job
 Beyond the cleanser, PLAN de G is selling two leave-on products. The Synbiotic Luxe Complete Serum combines several functions in one concentrated step, and the brand says it targets hydration, radiance, elasticity, the skin barrier and visible signs of ageing. That’s a long list for one dropper bottle, which is the whole point of the pitch.
 The Synbiotic Luxe Complete Serum, the “treat” step PLAN de G says can cover several jobs at once The Synbiotic Luxe Complete Cream is the finishing step, meant to lock in moisture and leave skin smoother and firmer-looking, according to the brand. Put all three together and you get a cleanse, treat and moisturise routine that PLAN de G describes as both considered and convenient.
 It’s worth being honest about what that adds up to. A cleanser, a serum and a moisturiser is a fairly classic routine, the kind many dermatology-minded skincare fans already swear by. The new part is the cleanser folding two or three steps into one, while the serum and cream promise to cover ground you’d otherwise spread across extra bottles.
 The Synbiotic Luxe Complete Cream rounds off the routine as PLAN de G’s moisturising step So, Should You Skip Steps?
 If you double cleanse every night and you’re tired of it, the cleanser is the product worth trying first, since it’s the one that removes whole steps from your evening. Just keep the waterproof-makeup caveat in mind before you commit. The serum and cream make more sense for people who want to trim a crowded shelf of serums down to one or two bottles, though their multi-benefit promises come from the brand and deserve a patient, few-weeks trial before you decide.
 The smartest version of “less is more” is knowing which step you can drop, and the cleanser makes that easiest to test. 
 Korean beauty fans who have planned a skincare haul around our South Korea travel guide can now pick up PLAN de G without the flight.
 🛍️ Products: PLAN de G Triple All-in-one Oil to Foam Cleanbeauty Cleanser, Synbiotic Luxe Complete Serum, Synbiotic Luxe Complete Cream
🛒 Where to buy: PLAN de G Online Store and Shopee
🧴 Note: The cleanser is intended for everyday makeup, not waterproof makeup
 If your routine has quietly grown into a part-time job, this is a low-stakes way to see how much of it you need. Browse the full line-up on the PLAN de G Online Store or through PLAN de G on Shopee , start with the cleanser, and let your skin tell you whether three steps are enough!
